当您的应用需要与星闪（NearLink/SparkLink）外设进行通信时，应使用NearLink Kit
典型场景包括：开发星闪鼠标、手写笔等外设的配对连接应用、在应用中实现星闪设备扫描与发现、通过星闪协议进行低功耗高速率数据传输等
当您需要开发基于SSAP协议的服务端或客户端应用、实现星闪设备间的加密配对与安全数据传输时，也应使用NearLink Kit
扫描附近的星闪外设并在列表中显示设备名称和信号强度 / Scan nearby NearLink peripherals and show device names and signal strength in a list
实现星闪设备配对绑定并建立加密连接 / Implement NearLink pairing and create an encrypted connection
连接星闪手写笔并实时接收笔迹数据 / Connect a NearLink stylus and receive stroke data in real time
接入星闪鼠标或键盘等外设输入 / Integrate input from NearLink mouse or keyboard peripherals
作为中心设备发现并连接低功耗星闪外设 / Discover and connect low-power NearLink peripherals as a central device
作为外围设备广播自身让其他设备搜索到 / Advertise as a NearLink peripheral so other devices can discover it
创建 SSAP 服务并暴露可读写特征值 / Create an SSAP service and expose readable and writable characteristics
通过 SSAP 订阅属性变化并接收设备状态通知 / Subscribe to SSAP characteristic changes and receive device status notifications
用星闪端口通道传输文件或连续数据流 / Transfer files or continuous data streams over a NearLink port channel
管理星闪连接状态变化并处理断开重连 / Manage NearLink connection state changes and handle disconnects and reconnection
监听系统星闪开关状态并在界面上提示用户开启 / Listen for the system NearLink toggle state and prompt the user to enable it in the UI
查询设备是否支持 NearLink 能力后再启用相关功能 / Check whether the device supports NearLink before enabling related features
do_not_use_when: 需求是通用互联网网络访问、HTTP/TCP/UDP套接字或Wi‑Fi/蜂窝网络管理，应改用 network-kit / If the task is general internet access, HTTP/TCP/UDP sockets, or Wi‑Fi/cellular network management, use network-kit instead
需求是网络链路加速、弱网优化、传输加速或QoS增强，应改用 network-boost-kit / If the task is network acceleration, poor-network optimization, transfer acceleration, or QoS enhancement, use network-boost-kit instead

需求是跨设备远程分布式通信、设备间能力调用或远端服务协同，而不是星闪近距离链路，应改用 remote-communication-kit / If the task is cross-device distributed communication, remote capability invocation, or remote service collaboration rather than a NearLink short-range link, use remote-communication-kit instead

需求是蓝牙、Wi‑Fi直连、NFC或其他通用连接能力，而非星闪协议栈与SSAP通信，应改用 connectivity-kit / If the task involves Bluetooth, Wi‑Fi Direct, NFC, or other general connectivity instead of the NearLink protocol stack and SSAP communication, use connectivity-kit instead
需求是蜂窝通话、拨号、来电或通话控制，应改用 telephony-kit 或 call-service-kit / If the task is cellular calling, dialing, incoming-call handling, or call control, use telephony-kit or call-service-kit instead
preconditions: 目标真机支持星闪功能，且不能在模拟器中运行 / The target physical device supports NearLink, and the app is not running in an emulator
设备已开启星闪开关，应用在运行时可访问该能力 / NearLink is enabled on the device, and the app can access the capability at runtime
已在 module.json5 中声明并申请所需星闪相关权限 / Required NearLink-related permissions have been declared and requested in module.json5
inputs: 中心端或外围端角色配置 / central or peripheral role configuration
扫描或广播参数 / scan or advertising parameters
SSAP服务UUID、特征UUID或实例配置 / SSAP service UUIDs, characteristic UUIDs, or instance configuration
目标设备标识或连接参数 / target device identifier or connection parameters
待发送的数据载荷或端口通道参数 / data payload to send or port channel parameters

postconditions.statement: 代码已先检查星闪能力或开关状态，再执行扫描、广播、连接或传输流程 / The code checks NearLink capability or switch state before scanning, advertising, connecting, or transferring
postconditions.judge_prompt: Does the edit set add logic that queries NearLink support and/or switch state before invoking discovery, advertising, connection, SSAP, or data-transfer APIs?

postconditions.statement: 已实现与目标场景匹配的星闪流程：广播/扫描、SSAP服务端/客户端或数据传输之一 / A NearLink flow matching the target scenario is implemented: advertising/scanning, SSAP server/client, or data transfer
postconditions.judge_prompt: Do the edits clearly implement at least one appropriate NearLink scenario flow such as advertising or scanning, SSAP server or client setup, or data transfer over a NearLink channel?

postconditions.statement: 对连接、配对或传输失败增加了错误处理或状态监听 / Error handling or state monitoring is added for connection, pairing, or transfer failures
postconditions.judge_prompt: Do the edits include callbacks, listeners, return-value checks, or exception handling for NearLink connection, pairing, scan, or transfer failure states?
